NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE LOCAL COUNCILS
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE LOCAL COUNCILS (ASSUMPTION OF OFFICE AND DECLARATION OF ASSETS) RULES,
1979
[Gazette of N.‑W. F. P.,
Extraordinary, 10th June 1980]
No. SO (ELC.) L G‑1
(i)/79.‑In exercise of the powers conferred by section 172 of the North‑West
Frontier Province Local Government Ordi nance, 1979 (N.‑W. F. P.
Ordinance IV of 1979), read with section 32 thereof, the Government of the
North‑West Frontier Province is pleased to make the following rules,
namely :‑----
1.‑‑(1) These rules
may be called the North‑West Frontier Province Local Councils
(Assumption. of Office and Declaration of Assets) Rules, 1975.
(2) They shall come into force
at once.
2. Definitions.‑In these rules, unless the context otherwise
requires;
(a) "Member" means a member of a Local Council ; and
(b) "Ordinance" means the North‑West Frontier
Province Local Government Ordinance, 1979 (N.‑W. F. P. Ordinance IV of
1979).
3. Notice for the meeting.‑As soon as may, after the election
of members of a Local Council, Government or an Officer authorised by Govern ment
in this behalf, shall, at three clear days' notice addressed ;
4. Presiding Officer.‑The meeting convened under rule 3 shall
be presided over by the outgoing Chairman of the Local Council concerned or by
such Office as Government may appoint in that behalf.
5. Oath of Offices.‑(1) In the meeting, the Presiding Officer
shall. administer oath of office to the members, in the form as set forth in
the Schedule to these rules.
(2) When the oath of office has
been taken by all members present in the meeting, all the members shall be
deemed to have assumed office. When the election of the reserved seats is
finalized and the members elected to the reserved seats also take oath of
office accordingly, the Local Council shall be deemed to have assumed office.
(3) If a member of Local
Council is unable to attend the meeting convened under rule 3, the Chairman of
the Local Council shall, at any subsequent meeting, administer oath of office
to such member, whereupon such member shall be deemed to have taken his seat in
the Local Council.
7. Declaration of assets.‑(1) Every member of the Local
Council shall, within seven days of assumption of office, declare his assets in
the form appended to these rules and deliver the same in a sealed envelope to
the Chief Officer of the Local Council or any other officer authorised by the
Government in that behalf for safe custody in such manner as may be specified
by Government in this behalf.
(2) Non‑submission of the
declaration of assets under sub‑rule (1) shall be misconduct on the part
of the member concerned within the meaning of section 34 of the Ordinance.
